note: the giant baked pasta drum, sliced at the table

dish.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead, turn out and reheat sliced

steps.text: Make a dough with the flour and eggs, knead and rest.
Brown the mince with the onion, add the passata and simmer to a ragù.
Roll the dough thin and line a buttered ovenproof bowl.
Toss the cooked ziti with ragù and layer in the bowl with salami, boiled egg and provolone.
Fold the dough over and bake at 180C for 1 hour.
Rest for 30 minutes, turn out and slice.

note: the main event, or pork belly if your oven is small

dish.make_ahead: Season and dry the pork in the fridge the night before

steps.text: Score the skin of the pork belly with a sharp knife. Turn it over and rub the flesh side with the fennel seeds, crushed garlic and chopped rosemary.
Rub the skin with the salt, roll the pork belly up and tie with string every 3cm.
Sit it on a rack and dry uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Roast at 240C for 30 minutes until the skin starts to blister.
Turn the oven down to 160C and roast for 2 hours until tender with crisp crackling.
Rest for 15 minutes, cut off the string and carve thick.

note: Grilled chicken, rice, black beans, cheddar and salsa in a toasted flour tortilla

steps.text: Grill the chicken thighs and slice.
Cook the rice.
Fill the tortillas with chicken, rice, beans, cheddar, salsa and sour cream.
Roll tight and toast in a dry pan.

note: Shredded chicken and cheddar rolled in corn tortillas under red enchilada sauce

steps.text: Simmer the chicken in some of the sauce.
Fill the warmed tortillas with the chicken and cheddar, roll and lay in a baking dish.
Pour over the remaining sauce and top with cheddar.
Bake at 190C.
Scatter with coriander.

note: spiked for Sea Bass, mild for you

steps.text: Brown a portion of the mince with the onion in the oil
Add the chilli powder, cumin, tomatoes and water, simmer until thick and season
Shape the remaining mince into four patties
Griddle over medium-high heat until cooked through (75C at the centre) and top with cheddar to melt
Toast the buns and fill with patties, chilli and jalapenos
Put the hot sauce on the table for anyone wanting the extra-hot version

note: Two smashed beef patties with American cheese, onion, pickles and mustard

steps.text: Dice the onion and portion the mince into eight balls
Smash into thin patties on a smoking griddle, salt and flip at 90 seconds, adding cheese
Toast the buns
Stack two patties per bun with onion, pickles, mustard and tomato sauce

note: Creamy beef and mushroom casserole under crisp tater tots and cheddar

dish.n: Minnesota beef and tater tot hotdish

steps.text: Brown the mince with the onion and mushrooms.
Stir in the cream and simmer until thick.
Tip into a dish and cover with tater tots and cheddar.
Bake at 200C until crisp.

note: Citrus garlic roast pork shoulder with black beans and fried banana

dish.n: Wall of Gaylord mojo roast pork

steps.text: Blitz the garlic, orange and lime juice, two teaspoons of the cumin, oregano, oil and salt. Rub over the pork.
Marinate overnight in the fridge. This step is the day before.
Roast covered at 160C, then uncovered at 200C.
Fry the onion and capsicum, add the beans and remaining cumin and simmer.
Cook the rice. Fry the banana slices in the butter.
Rest and shred the pork and serve with beans, rice and bananas.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales (2017)
note: Snapper fillets poached in coconut milk with tomato, garlic and chilli

steps.text: Crush the garlic, chop the chilli and dice the tomatoes.
Soften the garlic and chilli in oil, add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer.
Add the fish and simmer gently.
Cook the jasmine rice.
Squeeze in lime and serve over the rice.

note: Browned pork chops simmered in an onion roux gravy

steps.text: Season, flour and brown the chops
Make a dark roux with the butter and flour
Add the onions, then the stock and thyme
Simmer the chops in the gravy
Cook the rice and serve the chops over it

film: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader (2010)
note: Crisp skin snapper in lemon caper butter, lightly crushed baby potatoes

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender and crush lightly.
Pan-fry the fish skin side down until crisp, then flip for a minute.
Add butter, lemon juice and capers to the pan.
Spoon over the fish and serve with the potatoes.

note: Golden pan fried white fish with brown butter and capers, minty new potatoes

dish.n: Mr Tuttle's garden potatoes and fish

ingredients.item: white fish fillets, such as flathead

steps.text: Boil the potatoes with the mint until tender and toss in salted butter.
Pan-fry the fish until golden.
Brown some butter, add the capers and lemon juice, and spoon over the fish.

note: Rump steaks with parsley garlic butter and roast potatoes

dish.n: Weight room rump with garlic butter

steps.text: Toss the potatoes in oil and salt.
Roast at 220C until crisp.
Mash the soft butter with garlic and parsley.
Season the steaks and grill over high heat for medium.
Rest the steaks and blanch the beans, tossing them with butter.
Top each steak with a slice of garlic butter.

note: Beef stock soup with beetroot, carrot, cabbage and potato, sharpened with vinegar

steps.text: Grate the beetroot and carrots, shred the cabbage and dice the potatoes.
Simmer all the vegetables in the stock until tender.
Add the vinegar and plenty of dill.
Serve with a big spoon of sour cream and rye bread.

note: Lamb neck, pearl barley, leeks, carrots and turnips

steps.text: Simmer the lamb and barley in the water.
Slice and dice the vegetables.
Add the vegetables and simmer again.
Shred the lamb back into the pot.
Season well and stir through the parsley.

note: Beef brisket braised with onions, tomato paste and paprika, sliced across the grain

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently in its juices

steps.text: Brown the brisket in oil on all sides
Lay the onions in a roasting dish and sit the brisket on top
Mix the stock with tomato paste and paprika, pour over, cover tightly and braise at 150C
Rest, slice across the grain and spoon over the juices

note: Crispy pork tossed with pineapple and peppers, egg fried rice on the side

dish.n: Sweet and sour pork with egg fried rice

steps.text: Cut the pork into chunks, coat in cornflour.
Fry in batches until crisp.
Simmer rice vinegar, sugar and tomato sauce, add pineapple and sliced capsicum.
Make egg fried rice from the cold rice.
Toss the pork through the sauce and serve with the rice.

note: Buttermilk fried chicken brushed with cayenne hot oil, served on white bread

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in the buttermilk in the fridge, at least 4 hours or overnight.
Dredge in seasoned flour and fry at 165C until crisp and cooked through.
Whisk a few spoonfuls of the hot oil with the cayenne, brown sugar and paprika and brush over the chicken.
Serve on white bread with pickles.

note: Slow roast harissa lamb shoulder pulled apart, hummus, charred peppers, flatbread

dish.make_ahead: Lamb up to 1 day ahead, reheat covered

steps.text: Rub the lamb with the harissa, garlic and cumin.
Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart.
Blitz the chickpeas with the tahini, a splash of water and salt into hummus.
Char the capsicums over a flame, peel and slice.
Blister the flatbreads in a hot pan and serve everything together.

note: Wok-seared beef, red onion and tomato with soy, over crisp fries

steps.text: Bake the frozen fries until crisp.
Sear the sliced beef rump in a smoking wok, add the sliced red onion and the tomatoes in wedges, then the soy and the vinegar.
Toss through the chips and serve with the cooked rice.

film: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021)
note: Whole snapper steamed with ginger and scallion, soy and sizzling oil, rice and bok choy

steps.text: Score the snapper and lay over the ginger and half the spring onion on a plate.
Steam until the flesh is opaque at the bone.
Cook the rice and steam the bok choy.
Top the fish with fresh spring onion, pour over the soy, then smoking hot oil.

note: Lamb shanks braised with red wine, tomato and rosemary

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

steps.text: Brown the shanks in oil
Soften the onion and carrots
Add the wine, tomatoes and rosemary, return the shanks, cover and braise at 160C
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter

note: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, onion and pickles, crinkle cut fries

steps.text: Cut the potatoes crinkle style and fry at 140C until soft, then drain.
Shape eight thin patties and slice the onion and pickles.
Smash the patties on a smoking griddle and add the cheese.
Toast the buns and stack two patties per bun with onion and pickles.
Fry the chips again at 185C until crisp. Wrap one to take home.

note: Bacon and kimchi fried with cold rice

dish.n: KTX to Busan kimchi fried rice
dish.make_ahead: Cook the rice a day ahead

steps.text: Cook the rice and let it go cold
Fry the bacon until crisp
Add the kimchi and a splash of its juice
Add the cold rice, gochujang and butter and press flat to crisp the bottom
Top each bowl with a fried egg and torn nori

note: Grilled lobster tails with garlic lemon butter, buttered potatoes and salad

steps.text: Split the lobster tails
Melt some of the butter with the garlic and lemon zest and brush over
Grill flesh side up until cooked through
Boil the potatoes until tender and toss with butter
Serve with dressed salad leaves and lemon wedges

note: Rib eyes basted in butter and crushed garlic, buttery mash

steps.text: Roast garlic cloves for the mash while the oven is on.
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter and roasted garlic.
Sear the steaks in a hot pan, then add butter and crushed garlic and baste for two minutes.
Rest the steaks and steam the broccolini.

note: Beef mince chilli with tomatoes and kidney beans

steps.text: Brown the mince with the onion and garlic.
Add the chilli powder, cumin, tomatoes and beans.
Simmer until thick.
Serve with cheddar and corn chips.

note: Beef and pork meatballs with allspice in cream gravy, served with potatoes

steps.text: Mix the mince with the breadcrumbs, onion and allspice and roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in butter.
Simmer in the stock and cream.
Boil the potatoes, mash with some butter and serve with lingonberry jam.

film: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull (2008)
note: Charred garlic cumin drumsticks with green cilantro jalapeño sauce, and fries

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, roast fresh

steps.text: Marinate the drumsticks in the garlic, cumin, paprika and lime juice.
Roast at 220C until charred and cooked through.
Blitz the coriander, jalapeno, mayonnaise and a squeeze of lime for the sauce.
Fry the fries twice, first at a low heat then until crisp. Serve with the chicken.

note: Seared beef patties on jasmine rice under onion gravy

dish.n: Loco moco, patties over rice with gravy

steps.text: Shape the mince into patties and sear in a hot pan. Cook through.
Cook the rice.
In the same pan, soften the onion in butter, stir in the flour and then the stock until thick.
Fry the eggs. Serve patties on rice with gravy and a fried egg.

note: Smashed beef patties, cheese, onions and pickles on brioche buns

ingredients.item: chopped dill pickles, plus slices to serve

steps.text: Slowly fry the onions in the butter until jammy.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, mustard and chopped pickles into a sauce.
Roll the mince into balls, smash flat in a very hot oiled pan, season and cook, then flip and add cheese.
Toast the buns and fill with sauce, patty, onions and pickles.

note: Thin crust pepperoni and mozzarella pizza drizzled with chili honey

dish.make_ahead: Dough can be stretched 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Stretch the dough into two thin bases.
Spread with crushed tomatoes and top with mozzarella and pepperoni.
Bake on a hot steel at maximum heat.
Warm the honey with chilli flakes and drizzle over.

note: one for each brother, Mikey calls the toppings

dish.make_ahead: Toppings can be prepped a day ahead

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms and capsicum and divide the dough into 4 balls.
Stretch each ball thin and top with sauce and mozzarella.
Top one pizza with pepperoni, one with mushrooms, one with pepperoni, mushroom and capsicum, and one with whatever is left in the fridge.
Bake each pizza on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting until golden and bubbling, one or two at a time.

film: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001)
note: Beef braised in dark ale under puff pastry, with buttery mash

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches, then soften the onions with the thyme.
Add the ale and braise until the beef is tender.
Thicken with the flour, pour into a pie dish, top with pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter and cook the peas.

note: Beef chuck slow braised with dried chiles, cumin and tomato

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, better the next day

steps.text: Soak the dried chillies in hot water, then blitz. Dice the beef, onion and garlic.
Brown the beef in batches.
Soften the onion and garlic, add the chillies, cumin and tomatoes.
Braise covered until tender. Serve with the cornbread.

note: Bacon, potato and corn chowder finished with cream

steps.text: Dice the bacon, onion and potatoes.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Soften the onion.
Add the potatoes, corn, thyme and water and simmer.
Stir in the cream and blitz a little for body.
Serve topped with chives.

note: Drumsticks brined overnight, rubbed with paprika, roasted until falling off the bone

dish.n: Uncle Dave's theme park turkey legs

steps.text: Dissolve the salt and sugar in the water with some of the paprika.
Brine the drumsticks in the fridge overnight.
Pat dry and rub with the rest of the paprika.
Roast at 150C until the meat pulls easily from the bone.

note: Prawns in a garlic, ginger, chilli and tomato sauce with swirled egg

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day, add prawns just before serving

steps.text: Crush the garlic, grate the ginger and chop the chillies.
Fry the aromatics in the oil until fragrant.
Add the tomato sauce, sugar and water and simmer.
Add the prawns and cook until pink.
Swirl in the beaten eggs and serve with soft buns to mop up the sauce.

note: Dark roux gumbo with smoked sausage, vegetables and prawns

steps.text: Stir the oil and flour over medium heat into a dark roux.
Dice the onion, celery and capsicum and slice the sausage. Peel the prawns.
Add the vegetables and garlic to the roux, then the stock and sausage. Simmer.
Cook the rice.
Add the prawns to the gumbo for the last few minutes and serve over the rice.

note: Beef rib roast, roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and gravy

steps.text: Season the beef well, overnight if possible.
Roast at 220C, then drop to 160C until 52C inside.
Rest the beef under foil.
Roast the potatoes in oil.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C.
Make gravy with the stock and pan juices.

note: Chicken and broccoli baked over rice in cream stock, cheddar on top

dish.n: Mum's chicken, broccoli and rice bake

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil in batches.
Spread the rice in a baking dish, add the chicken and broccoli, then pour over the hot stock mixed with the cream.
Cover and bake at 180C.
Top with cheddar and bake uncovered until golden.

note: Linguine with garlic butter prawns and crunchy toasted breadcrumbs

steps.text: Slice the garlic and chop the parsley.
Cook the linguine in salted water until al dente.
Toast the panko in oil until golden.
Heat the butter and oil, add the garlic and chilli flakes and cook briefly.
Add the prawns and cook until pink.
Add the wine and bubble.
Toss in the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water, lemon zest and juice and the parsley.
Top with the crumbs.

note: Chicken soup with corn, potatoes, cassava and green plantain

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Peel and chop the onion, garlic, potatoes, cassava and plantain, and cut the corn into chunks.
Simmer the chicken in water with the onion and garlic.
Add the corn, potatoes, cassava and plantain and simmer until thick.
Cook the rice while the soup simmers.
Finish with coriander and serve with rice and sliced avocado.

note: Two smashed beef patties, bacon and cheddar in a toasted bun

steps.text: Grill the bacon rashers until crisp.
Roll the beef mince into balls and smash flat on a very hot plate, season and cook 2 minutes.
Flip, top each with cheddar and cook 1 minute.
Mix the mayo, the tomato sauce, the mustard and the chopped pickles.
Toast the burger buns, spread with sauce and stack the patties, bacon, pickles and diced onion in.

note: Beef and pork meatloaf with tomato glaze, served with mash and peas

dish.make_ahead: Loaf up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Mix both minces with the breadcrumbs, egg, onion, salt and pepper.
Shape in a tin, glaze with tomato sauce and bake at 180C.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter. Cook the peas.
Slice the loaf thick and serve with mash and peas.

note: Beef short ribs roasted 5 hours with carrots, parsnips and potatoes in the juices

dish.n: Asgardian feast beef ribs with roast roots

steps.text: Rub the ribs with salt and cracked pepper.
Roast covered at 140C for 4 hours.
Add the carrots, parsnips and potatoes to the tray to roast in the juices for the last hour.
Serve on a big board with crusty bread.

note: Beef chuck stewed with red wine, onions and carrots

steps.text: Dice the onions and carrots.
Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Soften the vegetables, return the beef with red wine and water to cover and simmer.
Boil the potatoes and mash with plenty of butter.
Cook the potatoes.
Spoon the stew over the mash.

note: Thick rectangular pan pizza with crisp cheesy edges and pepperoni

steps.text: Press the dough into an oiled rectangular tin and prove for 30 minutes.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic into a sauce.
Cover the dough right to the edges with the cheeses and pepperoni.
Bake at 250C for 15 minutes.
Stripe the tomato sauce on top.

note: Clove studded leg ham glazed with honey, brown sugar and Dijon

steps.text: Remove the rind from the ham, score the fat and stud with cloves.
Simmer the honey, sugar, mustard and pineapple juice until syrupy.
Bake the ham at 180C, brushing with glaze every so often. Roast the potatoes in oil alongside.
Toss the pineapple, chilli, mint and lime juice for the salsa.
Slice the ham and serve with the salsa.

note: Eggplant layered with cinnamon spiced lamb and tomato

steps.text: Slice the eggplants 1cm thick, brush with oil and grill or fry until golden.
Brown the lamb with the onion and cinnamon, add the tomatoes and simmer.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk until thick and beat in the egg off the heat.
Layer eggplant and lamb in a dish and pour over the bechamel.
Bake at 180C until golden.

note: Beef and pork ragù simmered with red wine and a parmesan rind

dish.n: Hanna's three-hour beef and pork ragù

steps.text: Soften the diced onion, carrot and celery in the oil.
Add both minces and brown hard.
Pour in the wine and reduce, then add the tomatoes, parmesan rind and water.
Simmer gently, topping up with water.
Cook the rigatoni and toss through the ragu with a splash of pasta water.
Grate the parmesan over.

note: Slow cooked pork shoulder crisped in a pan, with charred tomatillo salsa

steps.text: Cut the pork into big chunks.
Simmer slowly in the lard with the halved orange, garlic, bay leaves and salt.
Char the tomatillos and chilli, then blitz with coriander.
Crisp the pork in a hot pan.
Warm the tortillas and serve with the pork and salsa.

note: Baked frittata with ham, potato, spinach and feta

dish.n: Mother's Day ham and spinach frittata
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat gently or serve at room temperature

steps.text: Dice the potato, onion and ham and crumble the feta.
Boil the potato until tender, then drain.
Fry the onion in oil in an ovenproof pan, add the potato, ham and spinach and stir until wilted.
Whisk the eggs with cream and salt, pour over and scatter with feta.
Cook on low heat until the edges set.
Bake at 180C until set and golden.
Serve with rocket dressed in lemon and relish.

note: Seared beef strips in a mushroom, paprika and sour cream sauce over egg noodles

steps.text: Slice the onion and mushrooms.
Sear the beef strips fast in batches and set aside.
Brown the mushrooms and onion, add the paprika, Dijon and stock and reduce.
Boil the noodles and drain.
Stir in the sour cream off the heat and return the beef. Serve over the noodles.

note: Two smashed patties with bacon, onion rings and barbecue sauce

steps.text: Slice the onion into rings and soak in the milk.
Dredge in flour and fry into rings.
Grill the bacon until crisp.
Smash eight patties from the mince on a hot griddle and top with cheese.
Stack two per toasted bun with bacon, onion rings and barbecue sauce.

note: Short ribs rubbed with paprika and pepper, cooked low for five hours

steps.text: Rub the ribs with smoked paprika, pepper and salt.
Cook at 140C until tender with a dark crust.
Rest the ribs.
Char the corn cobs on a hot grill, turning.
Shred the cabbage and grate the carrot, then mix with the mayonnaise and vinegar for a crunchy coleslaw.

note: Grilled lime and chilli chicken thighs, long grain rice and black beans

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in lime juice, crushed garlic, chopped chilli and salt.
Leave to marinate.
Cook the rice and warm the drained beans.
Grill the chicken until charred and cooked through.
Make a salsa of diced tomato, red onion and lime.

film: What We Do in the Shadows (2014)
note: Rare sirloin sliced thin in soft rolls with horseradish cream

dish.make_ahead: Beef up to 1 day ahead, assemble fresh

steps.text: Season the beef and sear on all sides in a hot pan.
Roast at 200C for rare.
Rest the beef, then slice thin.
Fill the rolls with beef, horseradish cream and a handful of rocket each.

note: Seared rib eyes, buttery mashed potato and caramelized onion gravy

dish.n: Rib eye with onion gravy and mash

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with most of the butter and the milk.
Cook the onions in butter until deep golden, stir in the flour, then add the stock and simmer.
Sear the steaks hard in a smoking pan.
Rest the steaks and pour the gravy over.

note: Dark roux gumbo with chicken, smoked sausage and okra, served over rice

steps.text: Stir the flour into the oil over medium heat until it turns dark brown.
Add the onion, capsicum and celery and soften.
Add the chicken, sausage, okra and water and simmer until rich and thick.
Cook the rice and serve the gumbo over it.

note: Fried beef patties with tasty cheese and lettuce in toasted buns

steps.text: Shape the mince into 4 patties and season.
Fry the patties, adding a slice of cheese at the end.
Toast the buns and build with lettuce, tomato, beetroot, the patty and tomato sauce.

note: Beef chuck, carrots and onions simmered 3 hours in stout, with crusty bread

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in a heavy pot.
Add the onions, carrots and paprika and stir for a few minutes.
Pour in the stout and enough water to cover.
Simmer gently until thick and tender.
Serve in big bowls with crusty bread.

note: Beef meatloaf with a brown sugar tomato glaze

steps.text: Mix the mince with the onion, breadcrumbs, egg and salt and press into a loaf tin.
Spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.
Bake at 180C.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and cook the peas.
Serve thick slices with mash and peas.

note: Beef meatloaf glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar

steps.text: Grate the onion. Mix with the mince, breadcrumbs, egg and salt.
Press into a loaf tin and spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.
Bake at 180C.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter, and cook the peas.
Cook.
Serve thick slices with mash and peas.

note: Beef and pork meatballs in tomato sauce on long rolls with melted provolone

steps.text: Mix the mince with the egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan and salt and roll into meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in oil.
Simmer in the passata with crushed garlic.
Pack into the rolls, top with provolone and grill until melted.

note: the fiancé allergic to everything

steps.text: Mix the panko with parsley, lemon zest and oil.
Press onto the salmon and roast at 200C.
Steam the beans.
Melt the butter with the lemon juice and spoon over everything.

note: the Irish pub where the crew drinks

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry well. Whisk the batter flour, cornflour and cold lager together.
Fry the chips in oil at 140C until pale and soft, then drain.
Cook the peas, then crush with the butter and chopped mint and keep warm.
Dust the fish in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C in batches until golden and crisp.
Fry the chips again at 185C until crisp. Salt well and serve with the fish, peas and malt vinegar.

note: Garlic bacon prawns over cheddar polenta

steps.text: Peel the prawns and prepare the spring onions.
Simmer the polenta in the water, stirring, until thick.
Beat the cheddar into the polenta.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Add the garlic, prawns and Cajun seasoning and cook until the prawns are pink.
Spoon over the polenta and scatter with spring onion.

note: Grilled chicken thighs in barbecue sauce, charred corn, creamy slaw, soft rolls

dish.n: Beach house barbecue chicken and corn

steps.text: Grill the chicken and corn over coals.
Brush the chicken with barbecue sauce in the last minutes.
Mix the cabbage with the mayo for slaw.
Serve with soft rolls.
